svg.title: Fixed Workflow or Agent?
svg.desc: A decision chain for a freight-exception handler: if the steps can be listed in advance use a fixed workflow, if the path depends on tool results use an agent loop, and add a supervisor with subagents only when one context cannot hold the work.
svg.text: Orrin Freight: ask in order; add a supervisor only when one context cannot hold the work.
Customs hold: look up the manifest, draft the notice,
send it. Same order every run.
Damaged pallet: the next call depends on what the
photo and the carrier API return.
Port strike: one subagent per carrier,
each in its own context; only summaries
